summary: Day 49 of 72 (Geometry Circles 2: Cyclic Quadrilaterals & Tangents): Opposite angles sum to 180 degrees. Ptolemy's Theorem (d1*d2 = ac + bd). Direct and Transverse Common Tangents lengths.

urgent_alerts.title: CAT 2026 Admit Card Release
urgent_alerts.action: Download CAT 2026 admit card on iimcat.ac.in (expected early Nov, verify on iimcat.ac.in). Note allocated slot (Slot 1, 2, or 3), and align mock tests with slot timing.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Job Search Recruiter Triage & Screening Replies
blocks.details: 15–30 min recruiter communications triage: reply to inbound messages, confirm availability, schedule technical screenings, and follow up on pending submissions.

blocks.title: CAT Day 49: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: 20 Questions on Cyclic Quads and Common Tangents: sqrt(d^2 - (r1-r2)^2) vs sqrt(d^2 - (r1+r2)^2).. DILR: Unconventional / Miscellaneous DILR Logic: Word puzzles, matrix cryptarithms, and symbol substitution games..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 49: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: CL MyZone VARC: Full-length RC Sectional Drill (4 Passages, 16 Qs in 28 minutes). Track pace per passage. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
